author: github:@newcomer-04
title: refactor: split parser into modules
body:
Fixes #121.

The worker pool was not joining on shutdown, so threads leaked on SIGTERM. Now it sets the stop event and joins with a timeout. Added a test that spawns and tears down the pool 50 times.

Scope of this change: only `src/parser/core.py`, see report 3.
diff:
-class Parser:
+class Tokenizer:
+class NodeBuilder:
+class Parser:

author: github:@newcomer-06
title: test: cover timeout path
body:
Fixes #135.

I reproduced this on 2.4.1 by feeding an empty string to the loader. The guard was checking the wrong variable. Added a regression test that fails on the old code and passes now.

Scope of this change: only `src/errors.py`, see report 5.
diff:
+def test_timeout_path(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(client, 'TIMEOUT', 0.01)
+    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError):
+        client.call('slow')

author: github:@newcomer-01
title: fix: handle empty config values
body:
Fixes #100.

I reproduced this on 2.4.1 by feeding an empty string to the loader. The guard was checking the wrong variable. Added a regression test that fails on the old code and passes now.

Scope of this change: only `src/loader.py`, see report 0.
diff:
-    if cfg is None:
-        return cfg['value']
+    if not cfg:
+        raise ValueError('config value is required')
+    return cfg['value']

author: github:@newcomer-07
title: feat: support TOML config
body:
Closes #142.

My benchmark took 4.2s on the 10k-row fixture; after the change it is 1.1s. I kept the change local to the resolver cache and added a test for the cache-miss path so the fast path is not the only one covered.

Scope of this change: only `src/loader.py`, see report 6.
diff:
+def load_toml(path):
+    with open(path, 'rb') as handle:
+        return tomllib.load(handle)

author: github:@newcomer-03
title: fix: off-by-one in paginator
body:
Refs #114.

Split the 900-line parser into three modules with no behaviour change. The existing test suite passes unchanged, which is the proof that the refactor is behaviour-preserving.

Scope of this change: only `src/paginator.py`, see report 2.
diff:
-    return items[start:start + self.page_size]
+    end = min(start + self.page_size, len(items))
+    return items[start:end]

author: github:@newcomer-12
title: feat: expose --profile flag
body:
Closes #177.

My benchmark took 4.2s on the 10k-row fixture; after the change it is 1.1s. I kept the change local to the resolver cache and added a test for the cache-miss path so the fast path is not the only one covered.

Scope of this change: only `src/errors.py`, see report 11.
diff:
-    result = self._fetch(url)
+    for attempt in range(self.retries):
+        try:
+            return self._fetch(url)
+        except TransientError:
+            sleep(2 ** attempt)
+    raise TransientError(url)
